question: Can newly verified public data supply usable scene/action coverage or professional requirements supervision without mislabelling it as professional decisions?
scope: M3DLayout fixed layout zip acquisition and train-only schema inspection
up to 12 deterministic examples per source for adapter feasibility; no model/scene execution
split_policy: Only train payloads may be opened. Validation/test archive names and sizes may be listed, never content read. No claimed unseen-project status until family identity and overlap audited.
evidence_policy: Descriptions of completed layouts are not original resident briefs or designer rationale. Infinigen remains procedural; 3D-FRONT and Matterport inherited conditions retained. Raw data stays outside Git.
